title: Hosea Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Hosea 14: a call to return with words, healing promised, and Israel blossoming like the lily.

questions.text: Why does verse 1 say Israel has fallen?
questions.explanation: Israel is told to return to Yahweh its God, because it has fallen because of its sin.

answers.text: Because of the sword of Assyria
Because of famine in the land

questions.text: What are they told to take with them when they return?
questions.explanation: They are told to take words with them and return to Yahweh, asking him to forgive all their sins.

questions.text: What do they say they offer like bulls?
questions.explanation: They say they offer their lips like bulls, asking God to accept that which is good.

questions.text: What do they say they will no longer do, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: They say Assyria cannot save them, that they will not ride on horses, and that they will no longer call the work of their hands their gods.

questions.text: Who finds mercy in him, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: They say that in him the fatherless finds mercy.

questions.text: What does God promise in verse 4?
questions.explanation: God says he will heal their waywardness and love them freely, for his anger is turned away from him.

answers.text: To send them away into exile
To raise up another king for them
To heal their waywardness and love them freely
To hide his face from them forever

questions.text: Like what will Israel blossom, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: God says he will be like the dew to Israel, who will blossom like the lily and send down his roots like Lebanon.

questions.text: His beauty will be like which tree, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: His branches will spread, his beauty will be like the olive tree and his fragrance like Lebanon.

questions.text: What does God compare himself to in verse 8?
questions.explanation: He says he is like a green cypress tree, and that from him their fruit is found.

questions.text: What happens to the rebellious, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: The ways of Yahweh are right and the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.

answers.text: They are made wise by them
